title: Lesson 8
paragraph: 環境保全と社会の仕組み

words.meaning: a change to the natural environment resulting from an activity
words.example: The study assesses the environmental impact of the new road.

words.meaning: the connected stages through which a product passes from raw materials to disposal or recovery
words.japaneseMeaning: ライフサイクル・製品の全生涯
words.example: The analysis considers the product's entire life cycle.
words.usageNote: ここでは製品の資源採取から廃棄・回収までの段階を指します。

words.meaning: an economic approach that keeps products and materials in use and reduces waste
words.example: Repair services can support a circular economy.

words.meaning: action that decreases the amount of material discarded
words.example: The restaurant introduced smaller portions as part of waste reduction.

words.meaning: a defined place managed to conserve nature and related values
words.example: Visitors follow special rules inside the protected area.

words.meaning: the destruction or change of places so they can no longer support the organisms that lived there
words.example: The new development caused habitat loss along the river.

words.meaning: the clearing of forest so that the land is used for another purpose
words.japaneseMeaning: 森林減少・森林の他用途への転換
words.example: The study links agricultural expansion to deforestation.

words.meaning: the establishment of trees on land that was recently forested
words.example: The reforestation project uses species suited to the local conditions.

sentencePractice.prompt: Trees are established again on land that recently lost its forest. The project is an example of ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Restoring tree cover to recently forested land identifies reforestation; clearing forest and removal of soil describe different processes.

words.meaning: repeated observations or measurements used to track environmental conditions over time
words.japaneseMeaning: 環境モニタリング・継続監視
words.example: Regular monitoring shows how river conditions change.

sentencePractice.prompt: The team measures river conditions at the same sites every month to track changes. This repeated checking is ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Repeated measurements to follow conditions are monitoring; repairing a natural area and transferring pollen are different activities.

words.meaning: an official rule intended to protect the environment or limit harmful activities
words.example: The factory reviewed the new environmental regulation.
